Four bone legs, long horizontal spine, swept-back armor retained. Twenty actual connected silhouettes; rows idle/walk/yoke-thrust/charge/hit. All source bodies share181px standing height. Extended charge requires256x192 frame to preserve tail, yoke and outstretched feet; world body scaling remains80px. Ground anchors follow supporting feet, x follows trunk between four legs. No per-frame stretch. Ground review correction: airborne charge feet retain their raised offset above the nominal ground; low weapon cap does not move body grounding.
